This is a sleeper hit. Really nice work. I'm not great at/for critting tales so I won't go quite that far but I will say that this does a great job of finding its vibe in a small space and stretching it for the whole piece. The theme is cohesive and tight. I think the "some say" in a prophetic/poetic manner doesnt especially work for me unless you're explicitly trying to work an unreliable narrative angle, but, the rest of the piece leaves me not caring.

Easy +1.
